name: deka
description: Deka monorepo — reservations for bars and cafés

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w frontend" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.check: concurrently -n py,js,e2e -c green,blue,yellow "npm run test:py" "npm run test:js" "npm run test:e2e"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:py && npm run lint:js
scripts.lint:py: uv run ruff check backend/src agent/src && uv run bandit -q -r backend/src agent/src && uv run pylint backend/src/backend agent/src/agent
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:py && npm run typecheck:js
